Field Manual 01: the schedule is the content.

People can't show up if they don't know when you're live. Four steps to a schedule that works:

1. Pick days you can actually keep.
2. Post it everywhere your audience is.
3. Go live on time.
4. Announce changes early.

Save this for your next planning day.
